ideas.title: Paint Rocks for Gems
ideas.hook: Pick up plain grey rocks, paint them, and the better your paint job the rarer the gem that forms inside. Line your shelf with every gem colour.
core_loop: Grab a plain rock from the quarry
Paint it with the colours you own
It cracks open into a gem based on your paint score
Sell gems for new paints and bigger rocks
ideas.twist: Matching the hidden colour hint on each rock boosts the gem tier, so painting well beats painting fast.
ideas.why_now: Paint × Stones is the top open gap (score 8.05). Paint / create is up 2.02x (Paint to Get Rich 22.9K CCU, Paint a Pancake 13.3K) and Stones / rocks / ores is the fastest theme at 2.62x (+1 Stone Skipping 42.7K, Lift Rock For Eggs 17.8K). "___ for ___" titles lead at 3.36x.
ideas.differentiator: Paint games pay for the picture; here the paint job decides what is hidden inside the rock.

ideas.title: Paint Eggs for Pets
ideas.hook: Every egg comes blank. The patterns and colours you paint on it decide which pet hatches out, so players hunt for the secret designs that hatch mythics.
core_loop: Buy a blank egg
Paint stripes, spots and colours on it
Hatch it and see which pet your design made
Use pet bonuses to afford rarer eggs and paints
ideas.twist: Certain colour combos are secret recipes for rare pets, and players share and trade the recipes.
ideas.why_now: Paint × Eggs is the second-largest open gap (7.35). Eggs is up 1.32x across 55 young games (Break and Steal an Egg 216.3K CCU, Climb For Animals Eggs 38.1K) and Paint / create is up 2.02x; the Collect + Hatch pair already pulls 283.7K young CCU.
ideas.differentiator: Egg games roll pets at random; here the player's own design steers the roll.

ideas.title: Unwrap Mummies for Loot
ideas.hook: Spin giant mummies to peel off their wraps layer by layer. Each one hides a golden relic, a cursed pet or a pile of coins in the middle.
core_loop: Grab a mummy from the tomb
Unwrap it layer by layer by tapping
Collect the relic at the centre
Upgrade hands to unwrap bigger tomb mummies
ideas.twist: Some mummies wake up halfway through and run, so you chase them down the tomb corridor to finish the job.
retention: Offline coins from your relic display
ideas.why_now: Collect × Ancient is an open gap (4.55). Break / mine / dig is the fastest mechanic at 3.18x (Break and Steal an Egg 216.3K, Drill for Eggs 11.6K) and peel-style games are hot (Peel THE Potato 19.3K at 24 days). Interiors are the fastest map style at 2.1x.
ideas.differentiator: Peel games reward the peeling itself; here every mummy hides a collectable and some fight back.

ideas.title: Kick for Sneakers
ideas.hook: Kick a ball into towers of shoe boxes. Every box you knock down drops a sneaker, and the rarest drip sits at the top of the tallest towers.
core_loop: Kick a ball at a box tower (+1 kick power each kick)
Knocked boxes drop sneakers
Wear sneakers for kick bonuses
Unlock bigger towers in new streets
ideas.twist: Your outfit is your stats: every rare sneaker you wear changes how your kick curves and how far it flies.
ideas.why_now: Hit × Fashion is an open gap (3.79). Hit / swing / launch is up 1.58x (+1 Stone Skipping 42.7K, +1 Pickaxe Swing for Eggs 11.2K) and Fashion / beauty is up 1.43x (Facecard: Makeup Showdown 14.6K at 10 days). Kick sports games like Street Soccer Pro (6.2K) are new and growing.
ideas.differentiator: Football games reward goals; here the knock-down loot is wearable and your look changes your kick.

ideas.title: +1 Dance Every Beat
ideas.hook: Every beat you hit gives +1 groove. Groove unlocks louder clubs, flashier moves and dance pets that boogie next to you.
core_loop: Tap on the beat for +1 groove
Spend groove on new moves and club entry
Hatch dance pets that multiply groove
Rebirth for a bigger stage
ideas.twist: Missing a beat drops your combo, so skilled players climb much faster than idle ones.
ideas.why_now: +1 × Music is an open gap (3.36). "+1 ___" titles are up 1.79x across 24 young games (+1 Stone Skipping 42.7K, +1 Karate Evolution 16.2K) and Music / dance is up 1.35x (Piano Rhythm Tiles 6.7K, Aura Dance Battles 3.3K).
ideas.differentiator: Dance games are social emote hubs; this turns rhythm into a +1 stat climb with real skill.

ideas.title: Sling for Relics
ideas.hook: Load a giant sling with boulders and smash open the sealed walls of ancient temples. Each wall you break spills relics across the sand.
core_loop: Load a boulder and aim your sling
Break temple walls for relics
Sell relics for stronger slings and heavier rocks
Unlock bigger temples deeper in the desert
ideas.twist: Hitting the glowing weak spot one-shots a wall and drops a rarer relic, so aim matters as much as power.
ideas.why_now: Hit × Ancient is an open gap (3.06). Break / mine / dig is up 3.18x and Hit / swing / launch 1.58x; Stones / rocks / ores is the top theme at 2.62x (+1 Stone Skipping 42.7K, Lift Rock For Eggs 17.8K). The Break + Collect pair has 216.3K young CCU from just one game.
ideas.differentiator: Smash games break cities up close; here you break from range and aim decides the loot.

ideas.title: Press Vinyl for Fans
ideas.hook: Run a tiny record shop. Press vinyls in the back room, stack them on shelves and watch fans queue for the hits.
core_loop: Press vinyls on your machine
Stock shelves and serve fans at the till
Earn cash to unlock new genres and machines
Grow the shop into a music megastore
ideas.twist: Each genre attracts a different crowd, and a hit record causes a rush that you have to keep stocked.
ideas.why_now: Sell × Music is an open gap (3.08). Sell / run a shop is up 1.52x (Sell Fries! 55.9K CCU at 24 days, Create Pottery 2.0K) and Music / dance is up 1.35x. Interiors are the fastest map style at 2.1x (Sell Fries! is one).
ideas.differentiator: Shop games sell food; this sells music, with genre crowds and hit-record rushes.

ideas.title: Stylists vs Critics
ideas.hook: Grumpy fashion critics march down the runway. Place stylists along the catwalk to give them makeovers before they reach the judges' table.
core_loop: Place stylists (hair, makeup, outfits) along the runway
Critics get makeovers as they pass
Earn applause to upgrade and place more stylists
Summon new stylists from fashion crates
ideas.twist: A critic who reaches the end fully styled cheers and adds to your score, so you aim for perfect looks, not just stopping them.
ideas.why_now: Tower defense × Fashion is an open gap (3.5). Tower defense is up 1.46x (Bunker vs Verity 29.3K, Cameraman Tower Defense 12.8K) and Fashion / beauty is up 1.43x (Facecard: Makeup Showdown 14.6K at 10 days); "___ vs ___" titles are up 1.27x.
ideas.differentiator: Tower defense games destroy enemies; here you style them, and a perfect look scores more than a block.

ideas.title: Draw for Powers
ideas.hook: Draw a symbol in the air and it becomes your superpower: a zigzag is lightning, a circle is a shield, a spiral is a tornado. Clean drawings hit harder.
core_loop: Draw a symbol to cast a power
Beat villains in the city to earn ink
Unlock new symbols for your power book
Combine symbols for combo powers
ideas.twist: Power strength comes from how neatly you draw, so skilled artists out-power big spenders.
ideas.why_now: Paint × Superheroes is an open gap (4.02). Paint / create is up 2.02x and Coloring & Drawing is the top rising subgenre at 1.69x (Paint a Pancake 13.3K, Hide In Pixels 5.6K); Superheroes / powers is up 1.26x (Superhero Arena 9.4K).
ideas.differentiator: Hero games hand you fixed powers; here what you draw is the power.

ideas.title: Thaw Ice for Seeds
ideas.hook: Your farm is frozen solid. Melt ice blocks with a flamethrower to free ancient seeds, then plant them in the warm patches you clear.
core_loop: Melt ice blocks to free frozen seeds
Plant seeds in the thawed ground
Harvest and sell fire-fruit
Buy hotter torches to melt thicker ice
ideas.twist: The more ground you melt, the warmer your plot gets, so rarer tropical seeds start growing in the middle of the ice.
ideas.why_now: Ice / fire / elements is up 1.55x (Firefighting Sim 15.2K, Melt All The Ice 3.5K) and Break / mine / dig is the top mechanic at 3.18x. Grow / farm is up 1.39x (Prehistoric Farm 7.0K at 13 days), and "___ for ___" titles lead at 3.36x.
ideas.differentiator: Melting games end at the melt; here melting clears farmland and changes what you can grow.
